headword: {体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ}

definitions.explanation: A competitive athlete who performs gymnastics. Refers to those competing in artistic gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics, and other gymnastics disciplines.

examples.japanese: {体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}していた→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: She had been aiming to become a gymnast since childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧し、⟦{国中|くにじゅう}→国中：27766_kunijuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歓喜|かんき}→歓喜：13172_kanki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沸|わ}いた→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
examples.english: A Japanese gymnast won a gold medal at the Olympics, and the whole country erupted in joy.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧ (gymnastics, calisthenics) and ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (athlete, player). Japan has a strong tradition in competitive gymnastics, particularly in men's artistic gymnastics.

Note that ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧ alone can also mean simple exercises or calisthenics (as in {ラジオ体操|たいそう}), but in the compound {体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ} it refers to competitive gymnastics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧: a gymnast's performance
- {体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active as a gymnast
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ}: professional gymnast
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧{体操選手|たいそうせんしゅ}: former gymnast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: athlete — the general term for a competitive athlete
- {新体操選手|しんたいそうせんしゅ}: rhythmic gymnast — specifically rhythmic gymnastics
- ⟦{器械体操|きかいたいそう}→器械体操：28514_kikaitaisou⟧: apparatus gymnastics — gymnastics using equipment like bars, rings, etc.
